full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil painting fills the frame with a close-up of a young woman's face, surrounded by near black hair and saturated blue shadow. The dark hair arcs over the upper edge and falls down both sides, closing most of the space behind the head. At the upper left, one blue green eye looks slightly sideways beneath a heavy dark brow; the other eye near the upper center is brighter and more openly lit. The bridge of the nose runs down the middle through orange, pink, and white patches, while a dense cobalt shadow cuts across the left cheek. Broad slabs of pale cream and rose color catch the light on the right cheek and beneath the eye. The lips sit below the center as a strong band of magenta, crimson, and mauve, edged with abrupt darker marks rather than a continuous outline. The chin and neck are clipped by the lower frame, where sharp lemon yellow and electric blue accents interrupt the surrounding dark. Paint is spread in thick, angular strokes that cross the features and leave ridges, scrapes, and irregular seams between colors visible. Although the face remains recognizable, its rounded structure is built from interlocking planes of hot orange, cool blue, bright pink, green, and pale white instead of smooth flesh tones. Light appears to strike from the upper right, making the central forehead, cheek, nose, and lower lip flare against the shadowed left side. The deepest darks gather in the hair, eye sockets, and frame corners, pushing the face forward. The overall composition is intimate and confrontational, with bold color collisions and rough paint texture carrying the emotional force of the image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性油画让一名年轻女性的面部特写占满画框，四周围着近黑色头发与饱和的蓝色阴影。深色头发沿上缘弯曲，再从两侧垂下，封住头后大部分空间。左上方，一只蓝绿色眼睛从浓重的深色眉下略向一侧望去；靠上方中央的另一只眼睛更加明亮，也受到更多照射。鼻梁沿中部向下穿过橙、粉和白色色斑，浓厚的钴蓝阴影横切左侧面颊。浅奶油色和玫瑰色的大块颜料接住右颊及眼下的光。嘴唇位于中心下方，成为洋红、深红和淡紫色的强烈横带，其边缘由骤然加深的笔痕而非连续轮廓界定。下巴和颈部被画框下缘截断，明亮的柠檬黄与电蓝色重音打断四周深色。颜料以厚实、棱角分明的笔触铺开，跨过五官，保留色彩之间可见的隆起、刮痕和不规则接缝。面部仍然可辨，但其圆润结构由炽热橙色、冷蓝、亮粉、绿色和浅白色的咬合平面构成，而非平滑肤色。光似乎从右上方照来，使额头中央、面颊、鼻部和下唇在阴影较重的左侧旁骤然发亮。最深的暗色聚集在头发、眼窝和画框角落，把脸推向前方。整体构图亲密而逼人，以大胆的色彩碰撞和粗糙颜料肌理承载画面的情绪力量。
style_prompt_en: Thick oil color is organized into abrupt interlocking planes rather than blended local tones. Electric blue, cyan, hot pink, crimson, orange, lemon yellow, and sharp white are driven against near black passages, creating volume through intense temperature and value contrasts. Knife like strokes and blunt brush marks leave raised edges, scraped streaks, and visible seams where colors collide. Curved underlying forms remain legible, yet their surfaces fracture into angular facets that redirect the eye across the frame. Deep dark regions compress the outer space and make clustered high value marks appear to project forward. Highlights arrive in uneven patches from an upper diagonal direction, while cool saturated shadows remain just as chromatic as the lit areas. Strong cropping and dense placement leave almost no neutral resting area. The overall effect is visceral, luminous, and tactile, with expressive color planes doing the work of both modeling and emotion.
style_prompt_zh: 厚实油彩被组织成突然相接的咬合平面，而非调和的固有色。电蓝、青色、炽粉、深红、橙色、柠檬黄与锐利白色被推向近黑色区域，以强烈的冷暖和明度对比建立体积。刀刮般的笔触与钝厚刷痕留下隆起边缘、擦痕和色彩碰撞时可见的接缝。底层弯曲形体依然清晰，但表面碎裂为棱角切面，引导视线穿过画面。深暗区域压缩外围空间，使密集的高明度笔迹仿佛向前突出。高光以不均匀的色斑从上方斜向落下，冷色阴影仍和受光处一样饱和。强烈的裁切与密集布置几乎不留中性的休息区域。整体效果直接、发亮而有触感，表现性的色彩平面同时承担塑形与情绪表达。
theme_en: Close-up face painted in vivid fractured color
theme_zh: 以鲜烈破碎色块绘成的面部特写
name: Francoise Nielly
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
